chunks: And from one of his sermons (peace be upon him), which is among the wonderful sermons, called 'Al-Gharrā’.'

In it are the attributes of God, exalted is His majesty, then the exhortation to His piety, then the discouragement from the world, then what follows of entering the Resurrection, then the awakening of the people to their heedlessness, then his excellence (peace be upon him) in reminding.

key_terms.الْغَرَّاءُ: Al-Gharrā’ (The Brilliant/Sparkling), the name of the sermon

ai.seo_question: What is the structure and theme of Imam Ali's sermon Al-Gharrā’?
ai.summary: Known as 'The Brilliant' due to its radiant eloquence, this sermon is traditionally regarded as the opening of Nahj al-Balagha and serves as a comprehensive theological and ethical framework. It uniquely bridges the metaphysical description of Allah’s attributes with practical admonitions against worldly attachment, emphasizing the Imam’s pivotal role in guiding the heedless towards divine remembrance.

en.sayed-ali-raza: This sermon is called the al-Gharrā’ and it is one of the most wonderful sermons of Amīr al-mu’minin.
